sections.html: Corydoras burgessi is one of the orange blotch corys. All of them have a brightly shining spot on the neck, which glows from yellow to almost red depending on the light.

There are a good number of different species and varieties of orange blotch corys. In past years Corydoras burgessi was often difficult to obtain, and most of the fish supplied were varieties, for example spotted ones, which were less popular than the plain varieties. The pure form is now available again.
The glowing spot on the neck helps the fish stay together in a school in the black waters of their homeland.
